headline: Approved a $20,727.53 invoice from DAHAB Associates, four monthly $3,578.00 administration fee invoices, and four retirement requests.
summary: DAHAB presented its September 2026 preliminary performance report. Members also approved the 9.9.2026 minutes, five invoices, and four retirement requests.
decisions: Approved the 9.9.2026 HERB regular meeting minutes, with two abstentions; motion carried.
Approved a $20,727.53 invoice from DAHAB Associates for 2nd quarter full service, unanimously.
Approved a $3,578.00 administration fee invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC for July 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $3,578.00 administration fee invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC for August 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $3,578.00 administration fee invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC for September 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $3,578.00 administration fee invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC for October 2026, unanimously.
Approved the normal retirement of Special Education Paraprofessional Diane Cox as of September 11, 2026, unanimously.
Approved the normal retirement of Fire Marshal Brian Dolan as of September 30, 2026, unanimously.
Approved the normal retirement of Paraprofessional Elise McCarthy as of October 29, 2026, unanimously.
Approved the normal retirement of Detective Michael Scott Levenduski as of November 30, 2026, unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Retirement Board Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
3:00 PM, October 14, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 3:02 p.m. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Board Members: Chairperson, Mayor Adam Sendroff, Myron Hul, Joe Colello, Lieutenant 
Timothy McKeon, Inspector Brian Gilson, Chris Rhone, Henry Dove, Carl Porto II, and Bob 
Freeman. 
Staff Members: Lee Palmer, Ken Kelley, Zelema Harris 
Dahab Representative:Tom Donegan and David Lee 
Public Members:Bob Maturo 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. 9.9.2026 HERB Regular meeting minutes.  
  
• Chairman Sendroff moved to approve the minutes. 
• Board member Gibson seconded the motion. 
• Board members Carl Porto and Myron Hul abstained.  
• Motion carried. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 None. 
5. FINANCIAL 
  
 
 
 1. Presentation from DAHAB September 2026 preliminary performance report 
       
  
• September's preliminary performance reports were presented by Dahab
representative, David Lee. 
6. ADMINISTRATIVE 
  
 
 
 1. Invoice from DAHAB Associates in the total amount of $20,727.53 for 2nd Quarter full 
service from 4.01.2026 to 6.30.2026 
       
  
• Board member Tim McKeon motioned to approve the invoice. 
• Board member Myron Hul seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 2. Invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC in the total amount of $3,578.00 for 
administration fee for the month of July 2026. 
       
  
• Board member Tim McKeon motioned to approve the invoice. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 3. Invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC in the total amount of $3,578.00 for 
administration fee for the month of August 2026. 
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the invoice. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 4. Invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC in the total amount of $3,578.00 for 
administration fee for the month of September 2026. 
       
  
• Board member Tim McKeon motioned to approve the invoice. 
• Board member Brain Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 5. Invoice from Associated Administrators, LLC in the total amount of $3,578.00 for 
administration fee for the month of October 2026. 
       
  
• Board member Tim McKeon motioned to approve the invoice. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
7. RETIREMEMENTS
1. Correspondence from Special Education Paraprofessional Diane Cox requesting a 
normal retirement as of September 11, 2026 - Hamden Public Schools 
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 2. Correspondence from Fire Marshal Brian Dolan requesting a normal retirement as of 
September 30, 2026 - Hamden Fire Department 
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 3. Correspondence from Paraprofessional Elise McCarthy requesting a normal retirement 
as of October 29, 2026 - Hamden Public Schools 
       
  
• Chairperson Adam Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member Brian Gilson seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 4. Correspondence from Detective Michael Scott Levenduski requesting a normal 
retirement as of November 30, 2026 - Hamden Police Department 
       
  
• Chairperson Sendroff motioned to approve the retirement request. 
• Board member McKeon seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
8. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 None. 
9. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
10. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 None. 
11. NEW BUSINESS
None. 
12. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 3:21 p.m.
